title: How to Text ChatGPT on iMessage (ChatGPT Dots Guide)
summary: ChatGPT Pro users in the U.S. can now text their dot over iMessage and RCS. Setup steps, what works over text, and how to build your own iMessage AI agent.
body_markdown:
Day to day, texting works the way you'd expect. You send it a question or a task the same way you'd text anyone. It replies in the thread. If it's working on something in the background and finishes, it texts you. If it needs your approval before doing something, it sends a link that opens ChatGPT so you can review it there.


You can tell your dot when to text you and when to stay quiet. "Only text me when something needs a decision" is enough. Routine updates stay in ChatGPT.


### What Can a dot Do Over Text?


Your dot can send and receive text, photos and voice messages. It can text you first with updates. It can ask for your approval through a link. Every conversation is one-to-one between you and your dot. It can't text anyone else, and nobody else can text it.


### What a dot can and can't do over text


✓


Can


- Send and receive text, photos and voice messages
- Text you first with updates
- Ask for your approval through a link


✗


Can't


- Join group chats
- Make phone calls
- Start FaceTime from the text thread
- Text anyone else


Sources:[OpenAI Help Center](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001530-getting-started-with-your-dot) and[ChatGPT Learn](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots/channels) .


What it can't do: join group chats, make phone calls or start FaceTime from the text thread. You can still call your dot inside the ChatGPT app.


Calls happen in the ChatGPT app, not the text thread. Image:[OpenAI, ChatGPT Learn](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots/channels) .


### How to Control When Your dot Texts You


Tell it. There's no switch in settings. You tell your dot in plain language when to text you and when to keep updates inside ChatGPT. Something like "only text me when you need a decision" works. If you don't set that boundary, your dot will choose the channel on its own, and it may text you more than you want.


### Can ChatGPT Read Your Other Text Messages?


No. Your dot sees its own thread with you and nothing else. Turning on texting doesn't give it or OpenAI access to the rest of your messages.
